name: Open WebUI
summary: A chat interface for AI models.
description: Open WebUI is a chat interface for large language models, also for models that run on your own server. Teams use it to give each person one place to talk to AI models.
licence_note: Free to self-host. Keep the Open WebUI name and logo when more than 50 people use it in 30 days, unless you have a licence from Open WebUI.

settings.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
settings.label: Admin email
settings.help: You sign in with this email. The password is in the environment variable ADMIN_PASSWORD.

whats_new: The first version of the template.
first_steps: Sign in with your admin email and the password in the environment variable ADMIN_PASSWORD (Environment, Reveal). Change the password in Open WebUI: a change of the variable later does not change it. Then add a model provider in the admin settings.
